```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: grafana
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: grafana-secret
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
type: Opaque
stringData:
  admin-user: "admin"
  admin-password: "ChangeMeProductionPassword123!"
  secret-key: "SW2YcwTIb9zpOOhoPsMm"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: grafana-config
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
data:
  grafana.ini: |
    [paths]
    data = /var/lib/grafana
    logs = /var/log/grafana
    plugins = /var/lib/grafana/plugins
    provisioning = /etc/grafana/provisioning

    [server]
    protocol = http
    http_port = 3000
    domain = localhost
    enforce_domain = false
    enable_gzip = true

    [security]
    disable_initial_admin_creation = false
    admin_user = admin
    cookie_secure = false
    cookie_samesite = lax
    allow_embedding = false
    x_content_type_options = true
    x_xss_protection = true

    [users]
    allow_sign_up = false
    allow_org_create = false
    auto_assign_org = true
    auto_assign_org_role = Viewer
    default_theme = dark

    [auth.basic]
    enabled = true

    [analytics]
    reporting_enabled = false
    check_for_updates = true

    [log]
    mode = console
    level = info
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: grafana-pvc
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: grafana
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
    app.kubernetes.io/component: core
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
        app.kubernetes.io/component: core
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: grafana
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 472
        runAsGroup: 472
        fsGroup: 472
      containers:
        - name: grafana
          image: grafana/grafana:11.0.0
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          env:
            - name: GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: grafana-secret
                  key: admin-user
            - name: GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: grafana-secret
                  key: admin-password
            - name: GF_SECURITY_SECRET_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: grafana-secret
                  key: secret-key
            - name: GF_PATHS_CONFIG
              value: "/etc/grafana/grafana.ini"
            - name: GF_PATHS_DATA
              value: "/var/lib/grafana"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 3000
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 750Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
          volumeMounts:
            - name: storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/grafana
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/grafana/grafana.ini
              subPath: grafana.ini
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: grafana-pvc
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: grafana-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: grafana
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
```
